title: Who designs the digital realm of young people?
content: We very often ask young people to contribute their ideas about the future – whether for a research project, a fun workshop, or to incorporate their perspective into our plans. But how much scope do we actually give them to shape that future? And what happens when their ideas do not meet our expectations, or do not fit in with our plans and systems?
